summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Education to establish a pilot program that awards competitive grants to eligible partnerships for developing or integrating cybersecurity education into postsecondary career and technical education programs to improve the cybersecurity competencies of the critical infrastructure workforce.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a pilot program to award competitive grants for integrating cybersecurity education into postsecondary career and technical education programs. This directly involves federal spending to support specific educational initiatives at the postsecondary level, which falls under the umbrella of public education funding.
